decks.notes: This deck focuses on building a strong board presence by utilizing green devotion to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful threats such as Nissa, Who Shakes the World and Cavalier of Thorns. It also includes disruptive elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and efficient ramp spells while utilizing key lands like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx for additional mana generation.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and disruption spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It utilizes powerful creatures like Kroxa and Sheoldred to apply pressure, while also including removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to control the board. The deck also includes hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is built to support the deck's aggressive strategy, with a mix of lands that provide both red and black mana sources.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, allowing you to play powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast early in the game. The deck also includes cards like The Akroan War and Obliterating Bolt for removal and disruption, while utilizing Skysovereign, Consul Flagship for additional damage and control. With a mix of aggressive creatures and versatile spells, this deck aims to apply pressure on your opponent and maintain board presence to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with powerful creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bonecrusher Giant, backed up by disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board. Graveyard Trespasser and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional reach and card advantage. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's color requirements while providing utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Castle Locthwain. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The primary focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly through green devotion cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and utilize powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns to overwhelm the opponent in aggressive fashion. The inclusion of cards like Storm the Festival and Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset adds extra utility and card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain the pressure throughout the game with powerful green creatures and mana ramping strategies.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy using Elves. By utilizing cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to dig for key pieces, along with a combination of mana dorks and Elf lords like Elvish Clancaller and Shaman of the Pack, the deck aims to flood the board with creatures quickly and deal damage directly to the opponent. The inclusion of lands like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Lair of the Hydra provide additional mana sources and utility to support the aggressive Elf tribal strategy.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II combo to overwhelm the opponent. It includes control elements like Stubborn Denial and Supreme Verdict to protect the combo pieces and clear the board when needed. The deck also includes card draw and selection with Dig Through Time and Consider, as well as selective discard with Collective Brutality and Tainted Indulgence. Liliana of the Veil and Sorin, Vengeful Bloodlord provide additional value and disruption. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's requirements.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combination of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm opponents. By using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Satyr Wayfinder to fill the graveyard, and Eldritch Evolution to search for key pieces, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence. Thoughtseize and Grisly Salvage help control the opponent's hand and deck while cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional value and threats. Can't Stay Away acts as a backup plan to ensure the deck can continue its strategy even if disrupted.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on deploying efficient creatures and utilizing combat tricks to pressure opponents quickly. It also includes removal spells to deal with threats and utility lands to provide additional value. The deck's strength lies in its ability to maintain a consistent aggressive strategy while disrupting opponents' game plans. Additionally, the companion choice of Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck's overall game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient creatures and powerful spells.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast. The deck also includes various mana accelerators like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to quickly ramp up to the bigger threats. In addition, cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Reckless Stormseeker provide additional damage and board presence. The deck is designed to maintain pressure on the opponent and close out the game as quickly as possible.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays with cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to pressure the opponent quickly. Utilizing powerful creatures such as Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while pushing damage through. Additional disruption comes in the form of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore. With a splash of powerful lands to support its strategy, this deck looks to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful Rakdos aggro creatures and disruptive spells to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. By combining efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize with aggressive threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bonecrusher Giant, the deck aims to control the board and deal consistent damage to the opponent's life total. Additionally, cards like Misery's Shadow and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure a victory through a mix of damage and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with aggressive creatures like Righteous Valkyrie and Resplendent Angel, supported by cards like Bishop of Wings and Collected Company for additional value. The deck also includes disruption tools like Skyclave Apparition and Portable Hole to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Giada, Font of Hope and Emeria's Call provide a way to gain life and stabilize against aggressive opponents. The mana base is built to support the color requirements of the deck while also including utility lands like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx for ramp.

This deck focuses on creating a fast-paced, aggressive tempo with a combination of powerful spirit creatures and efficient control spells. By maximizing the abilities of creatures like Rattlechains, Shacklegeist, and Supreme Phantom, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Lofty Denial. The inclusion of Curious Obsession provides card advantage and further pressure, while Faceless Haven offers a versatile threat. Overall, the deck aims to maintain pressure, board control, and card advantage to outmaneuver opponents in Pioneer 1v1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, aggressive creatures known as "Weenies" while utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to boost their power. The deck also includes protection spells like Brave the Elements to protect your creatures and Castle Ardenvale to generate extra tokens. By curving out your plays and maintaining pressure on the opponent, you aim to quickly build a strong board presence and close out the game before your opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on building a fast and aggressive board presence by utilizing low-cost creatures with abilities that boost each other's power. By constantly adding to the board and buffing creatures with cards like Brave the Elements, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy by including colorless lands like Mutavault and Shefet Dunes to activate abilities and pump up the team. Overall, the deck aims to flood the battlefield with small but powerful creatures to rush the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with various mana dorks and enchantments, utilizing devotion to green to power up cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. Storm the Festival is used to search for key creatures or planeswalkers, while cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Oath of Nissa help fix mana and find key pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and planeswalkers, while also having access to flexible options like Karn, the Great Creator for additional utility.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up your own board presence with a variety of versatile creatures. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck. With a mix of removal, card draw, and ramp spells, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Bonecrusher Giant, supported by ramp from Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic. Cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide extra value and pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes removal spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War to deal with threats. Land choices like Mutavault and Lair of the Hydra help to ensure consistent mana production and aggression. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful creatures while maintaining control of the battlefield.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent while also incorporating powerful removal spells to control the board. The key strategy is to establish a fast and consistent board presence with efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast, supported by mana acceleration from Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. Additionally, the deck includes versatile threats like Esika's Chariot and Reckless Stormseeker to provide additional pressure on the opponent. With a mix of creature aggression and spell control, this Gruul Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly with Lotus Field while using cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hidden Strings to untap lands and generate even more mana. The deck uses cards like Impulse and Pore Over the Pages to dig through the deck and find combo pieces quickly. The combo finish involves casting Emergent Ultimatum to search for powerful cards like Omniscience or Behold the Beyond to overwhelm the opponent in a single turn. The deck also includes some permission cards like Baral, Chief of Compliance to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through various removal spells and hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain board presence. The inclusion of card draw with Sign in Blood helps maintain card advantage while also dealing damage. The deck's win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and disruption spells, while also utilizing its land base effectively with cards like Field of Ruin and Castle Locthwain.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, aiming to apply constant pressure and disrupt their strategy. It includes a mix of powerful threats like Kroxa and Sheoldred, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to control the board. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughseize and Misery's Shadow to strip the opponent's hand and slow down their game plan. With a strong mana base and versatile creatures, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to win the game through efficient aggression and disruption.

The main idea of this deck is to apply pressure to the opponent quickly by playing aggressive creatures such as Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bonecrusher Giant, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion through cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Misery's Shadow, as well as removal spells like Power Word Kill and Dreadbore to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence and control the game tempo to secure a victory in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 match.

This deck focuses on early aggression and disruption, utilizing efficient creatures and removal spells to quickly apply pressure to the opponent. The deck aims to strip the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and disrupt their game plan with removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill. Additionally, the deck has a strong graveyard theme with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser to further pressure the opponent. The deck's mana base is built to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of lands that produce both black and red mana.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly draining the opponent's life total through a combination of aggressive creatures and disruption spells. By utilizing powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Glorybringer, along with disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of efficient removal spells and hard-hitting creatures, the deck is designed to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately leading to a quick victory.

The main idea of this deck is to play aggressively with a focus on spirits in order to control the tempo of the game. By utilizing cards like Mausoleum Wanderer, Shacklegeist, and Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. Cards like Curious Obsession and Geistlight Snare allow for card advantage and disruption, while Faceless Haven provides a versatile threat. The inclusion of counterspells like Lofty Denial and Spell Pierce helps to protect the board and maintain control. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, evasive creatures and disruptive spells.

This UW Control deck focuses on planning, board control, and card advantage to outlast opponents and manipulate the game to its advantage. With a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw spells, it aims to control the board and outvalue opponents through its strong card selection and powerful planeswalkers. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents for incremental advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to both colors and allows for utility lands to improve matchups against specific deck archetypes.

The deck focuses on swarming the board with low-cost creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The strategy revolves around buffing up your creatures with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant, while protecting them with cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Brave the Elements. The goal is to apply constant pressure on the opponent, making it difficult for them to stabilize or recover. Castle Ardenvale and Shefet Dunes provide additional creature tokens and pump effects to further strengthen your board presence. The deck aims to win the game through sheer numbers and relentless aggression.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures and using anthem effects to pump them up. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small creatures while utilizing protection spells like "Brave the Elements" to ensure they can get in for damage. The inclusion of Mutavault and colorless lands allows for flexibility in mana fixing and providing additional threats to the board. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to flood the board with small, efficient creatures in order to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By using aggressive weenie white creatures like Hopeful Initiate and Luminarch Aspirant, along with powerful anthem effects from cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the goal is to build a strong, aggressive board presence and attack relentlessly. Protection spells like Brave the Elements help to keep the creatures safe from removal spells, while the efficient land base enables a fast start and consistent mana production.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of low-cost creatures that quickly build in power and can be protected with cards like Brave the Elements. By utilizing cards like Adeline and Luminarch Aspirant, you can create a strong presence on the battlefield and push for damage early on. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant provide additional buffs to your creatures, making them even more threatening. The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and pressuring the opponent with a swarm of weenies.
